lines.2: As usual, the whole class spent it buzzing with chatter.
lines.3: A bunch of hopeless idiots making all the noise they pleased.
lines.7: No one was here to scold us for this noisy atmosphere.
lines.8: Yoshimi, who always fussed around trying to keep everyone in line, wasn't here.
lines.9: 「Hey, where's Yoppi, our class rep, today?」
lines.11: Now that I was completely conscious of Yoshimi, I'd been checking to see when she arrived.
lines.12: But for some reason, she wasn't here today.
lines.13: 「Yoshimi has had perfect attendance... Kiriya-san, do you know anything?」
lines.14: 「No, not a thing. I'm worried myself.」
lines.15: Yoshimi was usually so kind that everyone got restless when she wasn't there.
lines.16: We'd all been helped by her in one way or another.
lines.17: As class representative, she'd become someone the classroom practically couldn't function without.
lines.19: It was enough to leave even the Princess looking subdued.
lines.21: In the end, Yoshimi never came to school.
lines.23: 「Hope it's just a cold or somethin'... You hear about people dying alone, y'know.」
lines.25: 「Without Yoppi around, this class kinda loses its balance, huh?」
